stable_traits.personality: Revealed to be a Darkfriend but dies fighting for the Light, seeking redemption.

characters.notes: Dies in battle crying 'The Light, and Shinowa!' as a redemptive act. Rand learns he was a Darkfriend but still considers him a friend.

stable_traits.physical_traits: bone and sinew hand (effect of dagger)
stable_traits.personality: Reluctant hero, increasingly affected by the cursed dagger.

characters.notes: Sounds the Horn of Valere. Still clutches the cursed ruby-tipped dagger.

aliases_observed.notes: Carries the Dragon's banner into battle.

stable_traits.personality: Driven by duty, struggling with identity as the Dragon Reborn, protective of Egwene.

aliases_observed.notes: Hawkwing and others address him this way, linking him to his past life.

characters.notes: Battles Ba'alzamon in the mist. Linked to the Horn of Valere through Mat's sounding. Confirmed as the Dragon Reborn by multiple sources.

stable_traits.personality: Loyal, brave despite being overwhelmed by events.

characters.notes: Fights alongside the heroes despite being overwhelmed. Honored by Artur Hawkwing with suggestion he might become a hero himself.
Held captive by the Seanchan as a damane. Rand's motivation for returning to Falme.

stable_traits.personality: Commanding, formal, honorable, bound to the Wheel.

characters.notes: Leads the Heroes of the Horn. Wields the sword Justice. Recognizes Rand as Lews Therin.

stable_traits.personality: Sharp-tongued, fond toward Lews Therin/Rand, a hero bound to the Wheel.

characters.notes: One of the Heroes of the Horn. Uses a gleaming silver bow and quiver with silver arrows. Teases Rand about choosing troublesome women.

stable_traits.personality: Warrior hero bound to the Wheel.

characters.notes: One of the Heroes of the Horn. Wields two swords with hilts sticking above his broad shoulders.

stable_traits.physical_traits: white hair, sharp eyes, fatherly looking

characters.notes: One of the Heroes of the Horn.

stable_traits.personality: Manipulative, arrogant, offers servitude or death.

factions.notes: The primary antagonist, claims to be the Dark One.

aliases_observed.notes: Used by others to refer to him.

characters.notes: Battles Rand in the mist. Wields a long black-charred staff. Stabbed through the heart by Rand's heron-mark blade.

stable_traits.personality: Dutiful commander, concerned for his son's memory of him.

characters.notes: Dies leading Whitecloak charge into Falme. His last thought is regret that Byar cannot tell his son Dain how he died.
Mentioned in Bornhald's dying thoughts as someone who would have told Dain of his father's death.
Bornhald's son, mentioned in his dying thoughts.
Captain of a ship in Falme harbor. Rand recognizes his face through his strange vision.
The group plans to bring the Horn of Valere and Mat's dagger to her.
Rand remembers his voice teaching him about choosing when to Sheathe the Sword.
Past incarnation of Rand, repeatedly referenced by the Heroes and Ba'alzamon. Rand is his reincarnation.
Rand's horse. Rears and throws Rand when Ba'alzamon appears, then disappears.
One of the Heroes, name shifts across Ages. Not individually acting, part of collective references.

appearances.whereabouts: Initially near Falme, then in the mist battling Ba'alzamon while simultaneously perceiving the battle in Falme.
appearances.notable_actions: Rides toward Falme, debates returning for Egwene, witnesses the Horn being sounded, receives the Dragon's banner, charges into battle, duels Ba'alzamon in a separate dimension within the mist, assumes the void and channels the One Power, drives his heron-mark sword into Ba'alzamon's heart.
appearances.demeanor: Conflicted, driven by duty and love for Egwene, increasingly calm and resolved as battle progresses, ultimately accepting his role.

appearances.whereabouts: With the group fleeing Falme, then in the mist with the Heroes.
appearances.notable_actions: Carries the Horn of Valere and the cursed dagger, sounds the Horn twice (summoning the Heroes and providing music for battle), fights in the fog.
appearances.demeanor: Anxious, protective of the dagger, laughing between Horn calls during the charge, fearful Rand might be going mad.

appearances.whereabouts: With the group, then bearing the Dragon's banner in battle.
appearances.notable_actions: Cuts down a sapling to make a pole for the Dragon's banner, rides into battle carrying the banner, swings his axe to defend the banner more than to harm enemies.
appearances.demeanor: Grave, accepting of his role, yellow eyes glowing during battle.

appearances.whereabouts: With the group throughout, rides into battle with the Heroes.
appearances.notable_actions: Insists on accompanying them despite being told to stay safe, fights with short sword and sword-breaker, is honored by Artur Hawkwing.
appearances.demeanor: Wide-eyed, anxious, brave despite being overwhelmed, proud when honored by Hawkwing.

appearances.whereabouts: Behind in Falme, fighting the Seanchan.
appearances.notable_actions: Shouts 'The Light, and Shinowa!' and leads a charge against the Seanchan, dying to buy time for the others to escape.
appearances.demeanor: Dying, triumphant in his final cry.

appearances.whereabouts: Emerges from the mist with the other Heroes, leads them in battle against the Seanchan in Falme.
appearances.notable_actions: Commands the Heroes, recognizes Rand as Lews Therin, requests the Dragon's banner, leads the charge into Falme, honors Hurin, fights the Seanchan.
appearances.demeanor: Commanding, formal, respectful to Rand, bound by the Pattern.

appearances.whereabouts: With the Heroes of the Horn.
appearances.notable_actions: Tests her bowstring, laughs and teases Rand about choosing troublesome women, rides into battle.

appearances.whereabouts: With the Heroes of the Horn.
appearances.notable_actions: Draws two swords, rides into battle.

appearances.whereabouts: With the Heroes of the Horn.
appearances.notable_actions: Rides with the Heroes into battle.

appearances.whereabouts: In the mist, separate dimension from the main battle.
appearances.notable_actions: Confronts Rand, attempts to recruit or destroy him, fights with a black-charred staff, stabs Rand in the side, is stabbed through the heart by Rand's sword.
appearances.demeanor: Arrogant, manipulative, increasingly furious, eyes blazing like furnaces.

appearances.notable_actions: Orders advance and charge, dies in an explosion caused by damane.
appearances.demeanor: Dutiful, regretful in his final moment.

appearances.whereabouts: Prisoner in Falme, possibly among the damane in the Seanchan ranks.
appearances.notable_actions: None directly; she is the object of Rand's concern and motivation.

appearances.whereabouts: On his ship in Falme harbor.
appearances.notable_actions: Waits with his crew; Rand perceives him through strange vision.
Rears and throws Rand, then vanishes.

relationships.description: Rand considers Ingtar his friend despite learning he was a Darkfriend; mourns his death.
Rand is driven to return to Falme to save Egwene from Seanchan captivity.
Mortal enemies; Rand duels Ba'alzamon and stabs him through the heart.
Hawkwing recognizes Rand as Lews Therin reborn and pledges to follow him and the Dragon's banner.
Rand is the reincarnation of Lews Therin; others address him as such.
Close friends fighting together; Mat sounds the Horn at Rand's implied direction.
Close friends; Perrin bears the Dragon's banner into battle for Rand.
Hurin serves and follows Rand loyally, calling him Lord Rand.
Fellow Heroes of the Horn bound to the Wheel together.
Fellow Heroes of the Horn bound to the Wheel together.
Father and son; Bornhald's dying thoughts are of his son.
Comrades in the Children of the Light; Bornhald wished Byar could tell Dain of his death.
